policy: Source-backed exterior stud/socket joins plus source-certified R4 through channels and complete shafts. Axial sliding requires the v2 contract and verified slide metadata; multiple receivers reserve non-overlapping shaft intervals. Other internal cavities, arbitrary pin joins and other joints remain unsupported. Keyed A6 joins use source-certified cross sections, complete beveled shafts and their shorter proven engagement intervals; each receiver reserves its entire interval. Standard access profiles remove only a source-certified empty outward column from the hull; verified active studs and all other separated features remain represented. Fixed 20-LDU Technic pin ends and stepped R8/R6/R8 holes require full-source void proofs and all 48 facet wall rectangles. Existing generated connectors retain their IDs when a pin hole is added. Only the reviewed frictionless whole pin is enabled; other pin shapes remain unsupported. Fixed minifig neck/head seating requires exact reviewed upper-neck geometry, source-preserving torso solids and a complete 16-facet head cavity with a full-source empty outward prism. Existing head connectors are preserved; arms and hips are not inferred. Paired minifig waist posts require exact reviewed upper geometry and torso interface, full-source empty outward prisms, fixed seating and aligned bevel headings. Existing foot and neck connectors are preserved. Arms and leg pivots remain separate mechanisms.
